definitions.explanation: Describes a situation where one entity controls something exclusively, shutting out others. Often used in business and economic contexts.

examples.japanese: {独占的|どくせんてき}な{地位|ちい}を{築|きず}く。
その{企業|きぎょう}は{市場|しじょう}で{独占的|どくせんてき}な{力|ちから}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: That company holds monopolistic power in the market.

examples.japanese: {独占的|どくせんてき}な{取引|とりひき}は{法律|ほうりつ}で{規制|きせい}されている。
examples.english: Monopolistic trading practices are regulated by law.

notes:
USAGE:
{独占的|どくせんてき} is formed from {独占|どくせん} (monopoly) + {的|てき} (adjective-forming suffix). It is commonly used in economic, legal, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独占的|どくせんてき}{地位|ちい} (monopolistic position)
- {独占的|どくせんてき}な{支配|しはい} (exclusive control)
- {独占的|どくせんてき}な{権利|けんり} (exclusive rights)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{排他的|はいたてき} (exclusive, exclusionary) focuses on shutting others out, while {独占的|どくせんてき} focuses on one party having sole control. {寡占的|かせんてき} describes an oligopoly where a few entities share dominance.
